## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Identify the affected experience or research contract and link a sanitized issue where applicable.

For an investigation change, explain what the user can now compare, inspect or decide. Distinguish a presentation change from a change to the model, recorded evidence or an operational control.

## Validation

List exact commands and actual results, including failures and missing prerequisites. Explain coverage and independent review where applicable. Include safe visual evidence for UI changes; state which viewport, theme and interaction it shows. A local check does not establish publication or deployment.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I have authority to contribute under Apache-2.0 and preserved third-party terms.
- [ ] No secrets, operational/private data or blind reference answers are included.
- [ ] Recorded evidence, human approvals and blinding/exposure records remain truthful.
- [ ] Retained comparison identity, reasoning and the separation of recommendation from authority remain intact where affected.
- [ ] Dependencies, lockfiles, docs and tests are consistent; pinned gates remain intact.
- [ ] Limitations and pending owner decisions are explicit; no production safety claim is implied.
